meta.title: Custom prompt search in Smart Supplier Scout

plan.title: Custom Smart Supplier Scout prompt search

args.goal: In the already-open Smart Supplier Scout panel, type a custom prompt describing the required product and location into its textbox, click the blue search icon, and stop when the panel visibly shows a list of vendor cards.

steps.note: Performs the custom prompt search and verifies the expected vendor-card list on screen.
Confirms the resulting panel has no crash, server error, or malformed content.
